style: Style: vintage Saturday-morning monster cartoon still with a real horror edge, a heavy painted gouache background with deep inky blacks and one coloured light source (lantern orange or ghostly green), flat cel-painted characters with clean black outlines, anything monstrous drawn with grotesque detail and glowing eyes, high contrast, unsettling. Wide cinematic frame. No faces of the heroes shown, no text, no lettering except where stated.

pictures.rk_master_stroke: Inside a cluttered post office, a sobbing young woman's shadow on the floor shows a beaked head and a puffed-up throat
pictures.rk_master_stroke_2: A young woman folding in on herself in a burst of grey feathers, an empty skin settling on the floorboards
pictures.rk_master_stroke_3: Through a window, a round dovecote rocking, rising on two huge scaly pigeon legs and hopping away over the roofs toward the moors
pictures.rk_village_turns: The village green full of torches, an oak with carved faces lit from below, a constable holding up a letter
pictures.rk_village_turns_2: Rows of pigeons along every roof ridge, all their heads turning together toward the viewer
pictures.rk_rookery_horizon: A moor at dusk with a tiny dovecote striding along the skyline on pigeon legs
pictures.rk_rookery_horizon_2: A muddy three-toed footprint the size of a cart, filling with rain
pictures.rk_home_to_roost: A dovecote's legs folding under it and its wings pulling back into the thatch as it thumps down for good
pictures.rk_home_to_roost_2: A dead pigeon-man in the straw of a dovecote floor, one human ear turned up to the rafters
pictures.rk_home_to_roost_3: A village street at morning with townsfolk standing blinking in the daylight, someone hanging the first strand of festival bunting
